item.title: Duras sanciones de la FIFA para Argentina: suspende a Paredes de diez partidos y multa a la AFA, que apelará
item.description: La FIFA impuso este viernes 21 de agosto sanciones a tres futbolistas de la selección argentina por los altercados posteriores a la final del Mundial contra España: Leandro Paredes es suspendido de diez partidos y Nahuel Molina de siete. Además, multó a la Asociación del Fútbol Argentino (AFA) por distintos incidentes del torneo, entre ellos la exhibición de una pancarta con el mensaje “Las Malvinas son argentinas”. La AFA anunció que recurrirá las decisiones ante los órganos de apelación y mantiene abierta la posibilidad de acudir al Tribunal de Arbitraje Deportivo (TAS). Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Retail sales in Great Britain fall despite heatwave increasing food and drink demand
item.description: Volume of goods sold in stores and online dropped 0.5% in July, ONS says Business live – latest updates Retail sales across Great Britain weakened last month despite the men’s football World Cup and record temperatures boosting the demand for food and drink. The Office for National Statistics said the volume of goods sold in stores and online fell 0.5% in July. That is down from 0.7% rise in June – revised down from initial estimates of 1% – and a 1.3% rise in May. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Conference League: Monaco take first-leg lead in Poland
item.description: Monaco won 3-2 away at Gornik Zabrze in the first leg of their Conference League play-off. Mika Biereth opened the scoring before Lamine Camara doubled Monaco’s lead after the break. Paris Brunner then restored the visitors’ advantage after the Polish side had twice reduced the deficit. Filipe Luis's side take a one-goal lead into next Thursday’s second leg at the Stade Louis-II. Fuente: France 24 - English.
